history.found: 2.1.227-232: vendor bat dau lam NATIVE dung phan viec cua dcg.mjs. Ba dong dang chu y: (1) 'Bash input redirections (< file) are now permission-checked like their argument spellings' - dcg.mjs cham lenh theo chuoi nen mot lenh doc qua '< file' truoc day di vong duoc; (2) '/commit-push-pr: git/gh commands with dangerous flags no longer auto-approved' - trung y voi dcg chan force push / reset --hard; (3) 'Hardened Linux filesystem sandbox against a protected-path bypass' + hai ban va bypass tren Windows (PowerShell PSDefaultParameterValues, Git Bash Cygwin symlink) - trung vung voi block-secrets.mjs + permissions.deny. KET LUAN: chua bo duoc hook nao. dcg.mjs van ma hoa BA NHOM NGUY HIEM rieng cua repo nay kem ly do va telemetry, thu native khong co. Nhung huong hoi tu da ro, nen lan deprecation review sau phai DO chu khong doan: chay test-hooks voi tung hook tat de xem native da bat duoc ca nao chua. Ngoai le dang ghi: 'Write tool so newer models can overwrite an existing file without reading first' - noi long mot gia dinh an toan, va repo nay khong co guard nao cho no.

2.1.221-226, ba cho vendor da lam san thu harness dang tu lam tay. (1) PERMISSION/BASH GUARD: 2.1.221 va .223 va nhieu ban truoc lien tuc va bypass cua chinh lop permission — zsh an lenh trong [[ ]], lenh dem bang tab/Unicode vo hinh, lenh tu che mot phan khoi bang kiem. dcg.mjs cua ta parse lenh bang tay nen co DUNG lop bypass do ma khong co ai va. Nen chuyen sang permissions.deny + sandbox cua vendor, giu dcg.mjs chi cho phan project-specific. Chinh harness-doctor da nhac 2 deny rule con thieu. (2) SANDBOX/SECRET: 2.1.224 them credential-masking (extract, decode jwt, awsPairs/sigv4), sua bypass denyRead co dau / o cuoi, va cho sandbox violation hien trong ket qua Bash. block-secrets.mjs + danger-zones §2 dang lam tay dung viec nay, va lam yeu hon (chi chan doc/ghi, khong mask duoc gia tri). (3) WORKTREE: 2.1.222 sua worktree-isolated session + subagent chay duoc lenh git pha vao checkout chinh, va 2.1.221 doi /fork sang tu tao worktree rieng. Ky luat 'mot issue mot worktree' cua ta gio co lop cuong che native. THEM: 2.1.225 co gateway spend-limit voi thong bao neu ro cap va gio reset — trung phan nao voi budget.monthlyUsdCap + capo-report.mjs (chi ap dung khi di qua gateway). VA MOT DIEU VE HANH VI: 2.1.222 doi loi tu choi khi model goi skill co disable-model-invocation — model duoc bao HAY NHO NGUOI CHAY, dung tu dien lai quy trinh. /pre-merge va /harness-propose deu co co do, va phien 2026-08-10 agent da thi hanh tay tung buoc thay vi nho nguoi. Can quyet: hoac bo disable-model-invocation, hoac ghi ro trong SKILL la agent duoc phep thi hanh tung buoc.
